stories.title: Palestinians told to leave homes in village where Israeli settlers besieged houses
stories.body: The mayor of Qusra says Israeli troops have been telling families to leave their houses, using some as barracks.

stories.title: Romania shuts only nuclear plant as heat causes huge drop in Danube River level
stories.body: The Cernavodă plant, which produces 20% of Romania's electricity, is not expected to be restarted within the next 10 days.

stories.title: Putin can no longer claim victory in Ukraine, Nobel Peace Prize winner tells BBC
stories.body: In an exclusive interview with the BBC’s Steve Rosenberg, Dmitry Muratov says the Kremlin leader can only "destroy Ukraine, not conquer it", with the war now in its fifth year.

stories.title: Conditions on US aircraft carrier at sea for more than 250 days raise alarms
stories.body: Thousands of sailors on the USS Abraham Lincoln have reportedly faced food shortages and broken plumbing, with some considering jumping overboard.

stories.title: Person fined after using foghorn to wake sleeping polar bear
stories.body: Under local regulations in the region, "it is forbidden to needlessly disturb, attract or pursue a polar bear".

stories.title: Eurovision Song Contest 2027 to be held in Burgas, Bulgaria
stories.body: The Black Sea location has been selected after Bulgarian singer Dara won this year's contest.

stories.title: Mangione lawyers to meet federal prosecutors amid reports of plea deal
stories.body: Mangione faces two federal charges of stalking resulting in death, each carrying a maximum sentence of life in prison.

stories.title: Family of Irish plane crash victim awarded $29m in damages
stories.body: A jury in Chicago in the US awarded the sum to Michael Ryan's family after his widow Naoise Connolly Ryan brought a civil suit against Boeing.

stories.title: Air India to test all pilots for banned substances
stories.body: It comes after one of its planes suddenly lost altitude last week, with a number of passengers injured.

stories.title: Four Canadian hockey stars remain suspended after sexual assault acquittal
stories.body: A fifth has been reinstated, though an appeals board found that the whole group broke Hockey Canada's code of conduct.

stories.title: Ebola outbreak on track to be deadliest ever, WHO chief says
stories.body: The outbreak, declared on 15 May, has caused more than 2,000 deaths, with thousands more reported cases.

stories.title: Presidential pardon for French alleged spy accused of plotting Mali coup
stories.body: France is yet to comment on Yann Vezilier's pardon and previously called the accusations "unfounded".

stories.title: Travis Kelce shares first details from his wedding to Taylor Swift: 'Best night of my life'
stories.body: In the comments, Kelce called Swift his "wife" for first time and said it was a "childhood dream" to wed at Madison Square Garden.

stories.title: French ambassador to CAR accused of misconduct at official residence faces disciplinary action
stories.body: The accusations against Bruno Foucher prompted investigations into a potential security breach.

stories.title: BTS star V reveals hearing loss battle during livestream
stories.body: The K-pop star says he has suffered hearing issues for over two years before revealing it publicly this week.

stories.title: Zambians voting as president bids for second term
stories.body: Hakainde Hichilema wants five more years but continued cost of living pressures have dented his appeal.

stories.title: Indian actor's video with endangered gibbon sparks investigation
stories.body: A deleted video of Tamil star Vikram cuddling an endangered gibbon has triggered an inquiry into how the animal entered India.

stories.title: Three men will be executed on the same day as death penalties rise in US
stories.body: Despite growing opposition to the death penalty, one state is behind the rising numbers.

stories.title: Japan PM says Putin's visit to disputed islands 'absolutely unacceptable'
stories.body: It was the first time the Russian leader had visited the Kuril islands, according to state media.

stories.title: Australian army whistleblower released on parole after more than two years in jail
stories.body: David McBride was jailed after pleading guilty to leaking military secrets about Afghanistan.
